items.question: Is InstaMax Premium safe to use?
items.answer: Yes, InstaMax is built with security in mind. We use advanced encryption and anti-ban technology to ensure your account remains safe and secure.

items.question: Will I get banned for using this?
items.answer: InstaMax includes built-in anti-ban protection. However, we always recommend following the platform's community guidelines to minimize any risk.

items.question: How do I update the app?
items.answer: You can always find the latest version on our website. Simply download the new APK and install it over the old one.

items.question: Do I need to uninstall the original Instagram?
items.answer: No, InstaMax can be installed alongside the original Instagram app without any issues.

items.question: Is it available for iOS?
items.answer: Currently, InstaMax is only available for Android devices. We are working on an iOS version for the future.
